name: Fast-tier model writes metadata and categories (today)
description: On card creation or refresh a fast-tier model writes the metadata, and after a run it places modified files into cards.
advantages: Built; the only arm that makes the model call.
disadvantages: Not measured; its cost, time and value are unknown until the metric is built.

name: QAR topic bootstrap
description: The topic cards QAR's bootstrap proposes for files no card covers: areas discovered, topics written per area, duplicates folded into the cards ``existing`` holds. Returns ``{id, name, keywords, summary, files}`` (files as paths); the bootstrap stamps, limits and writes them. With no model nothing can be identified and the answer is an empty list.
advantages: It is what production runs today: topic cards that join information from many files, so the store stays proportionate to its topics.
disadvantages: Every build spends model calls, and the cards cost more to refresh than a file index does.
